public_rationale: Read in context, the claim is about the round announced February 27, 2026, and it is hedged with 'evidence suggests.' Amazon's February 27 Form 8-K says its $15 billion purchase was due on March 31, 2026. Its other $35 billion was a contingent commitment. SoftBank's February 27 release sets its first $10 billion tranche for April 1, 2026. So the two largest documented parts were scheduled for after the March 3 post. I found no evidence that any investor in the round had transferred money by then. NVIDIA's payment date is not documented in the sources I could read. Its 10-K, cited by the speaker, described the deal as still being finalized. On the public evidence at the time, the claim holds.
limitations: NVIDIA's funding date could not be confirmed from a primary source.
'Nobody' read literally to include earlier rounds would be false. The context points to this round only.

our_interpretation: The context shows that 'nobody' means the investors in OpenAI's round announced February 27, 2026 (Amazon, NVIDIA, SoftBank). It does not mean any investor ever.
'Evidence suggests' is a hedge. I test whether public evidence on or before the post date (March 3, 2026) showed that none of these investors had yet funded their part of the round.
Target period: from the February 27, 2026 announcement to the post date.
criteria.support_condition: Filings or announcements available by March 3, 2026 show that the round investors' payments were scheduled for after that date or were not yet final.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible evidence shows that any investor in the February 2026 round had transferred money to OpenAI on or before March 3, 2026.
